maintained_by: experiments/build_sampling_lookup.py; do not edit generated rows
formula: R(n)=1-(1-h*p)^n; n is the smallest integer reaching target
p_definition: P(correct positive decision | effective target frame); scenario input, not overall accuracy
scope: one stream, stride equals window, warm O6N CPU, 448-long-edge images; 30% planning headroom
independence: explicit unvalidated assumption across sample opportunities; average frequency is not proof of independence

clip.hardware: O6N CPU; one Harness; one tested model service
clip.input_scope: existing mixed-replay.mp4; 448-long-edge JPEG; continuous file decoder; no simultaneous recording

extrapolation.formula: P=d*W+o*n; M=m*n; C=c*n; period=max(P,M,C)+g*n; each image is a separate evaluation and mark
extrapolation.basis: coefficients from steady frames; extrapolation, not multi-image or new-interval measurement

blip_vqa.hardware: O6N CPU; one Harness; one tested model service
blip_vqa.input_scope: existing mixed-replay.mp4; 448-long-edge JPEG; continuous file decoder; no simultaneous recording

extrapolation.formula: P=d*W+o*n; M=m*n; C=c*n; period=max(P,M,C)+g*n; each image is a separate evaluation and mark
extrapolation.basis: coefficients from steady frames; extrapolation, not multi-image or new-interval measurement

cache_audit.scope: Observed service counters; not all image computation is reusable

qwen.hardware: O6N CPU; one Harness; one Qwen service
qwen.input_scope: same mixed replay; exactly one current 448-long-edge image, fixed task prefix; historical decisions stay in ledger
qwen.preparation_basis: full replay preparation worker; registration is in pre-request context cost; excludes outer cache-quota bookkeeping
qwen.model_compute_basis: not separately measured end-to-end; llama prompt timing excludes image encoding; use actual request roundtrip

extrapolation.formula: P=d*W+o*n; M=m*n; C=c*n; period=max(P,M+C)+g*n; prepare prefetch with ordered request/commit
extrapolation.basis: single-frame current-mode short-run extrapolation; not long-duration or quality guarantee

clip.title: CLIP

diagnostic.label_basis: Assistant visual inspection of actual submitted preview frames; developer fixture, not independent human held-out annotation. 10s still shows cat at transition.

clip.assessment: 同采样点首轮严格判对50%；无猫误留0张，待定5张。这是10张开发素材诊断，不能直接作为独立概率p或家庭准确率。

limitations: All p/h values in rows are assumptions; the 20-frame development fixture does not calibrate them.
Sampling more can increase false retention; no validated false-positive/uncertain-retention rates are supplied.
Qwen history-dependent or joint-image decisions cannot establish independent-trial quality; history-free execution needs separate validation.
Native current coefficients come from repeated single-new-frame replay; new windows/intervals are extrapolations, not measured throughput.
One request and one mark per new image; Qwen context_mode distinguishes current-frame and historical rolling-image measurements.

Qwen current-frame profile measures the replay preparation worker, not outer quota bookkeeping; rolling-history profiles measure preparation substeps only. Costs are not guarantees for different inputs.
No HEVC, simultaneous live recording, cloud editing or long-duration costs were remeasured in this update.
Current SamplingPolicy accepts intervals up to 10 seconds; a budget requiring a larger interval needs an API/preset change and revalidation, not just lookup success.
Lookup returns a plan, not an installed sampling preset, runtime authorization, cloud budget or reliability certification.
